match.title: Arsenal vs Manchester City
match.h2h: Manchester City lead the overall head-to-head record with 23 wins to Arsenal's 12 and 10 draws, including a 2-1 Premier League win in April 2026, though Arsenal claimed a 3-0 victory when the sides most recently met in the August 2026 Community Shield.
